note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Kosovo, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database files Kosovo under the code KS (its metadata's country name for KS is Kosovo; its file XK holds no figures). Its metadata gives the figures in EUR, and its market exchange rate in local currency per euro (xlceux999i) is 1.0005 for 2024, the euro's, so they are read as EUR. Read 2026-10-31. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j, xlceuxi999 for xlceux999i), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]).
